title: Adaptive SAML 2.0 Setup Wizard with Fingerprint-Assisted Metadata Validation
creator: Maya Ortega
description: Build an adaptive SAML 2.0 setup wizard that guides org admins through metadata exchange and performs deterministic validation using fingerprinting and heuristic normalization. The wizard should support remote metadata URLs and manual XML upload, validate certificates and signatures (X.509), normalize entityIDs and ACS URLs, surface deterministic validation errors, and create an auditable record linked to RBAC v2 admin actions. The goal is to reduce misconfiguration, speed onboarding, and ensure every metadata exchange is captured in the audit log with enough details for incident investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Org admins (RBAC v2 role: org_admin) can initiate a SAML setup from Console and choose URL or file upload
Metadata fetched from a remote URL is fingerprinted (SHA-256) and validated against the IdP's certificates and signature blocks
Uploaded metadata is parsed and validated; non-fatal issues are surfaced as warnings and fatal issues block completion with explicit guidance
All exchanges (fetch/upload/validation result/user, timestamp, source IP, fingerprint) are written to the audit log and visible in the Console audit view
Wizard produces a normalized, canonical EntityDescriptor that is stored as the active metadata blob and exposed to the runtime/export endpoints
Rollback path: admins can revert to previous metadata versions; reverting is recorded in audit logs and requires org_admin permission
E2E tests cover URL fetch, file upload, SHA-256 fingerprint generation, signature verification, entityID normalization heuristics, and audit log entries
tech_notes: Backend endpoint: POST /api/admin/saml/metadata-exchange (payload: {source: 'url'|'upload', value: string, initiator: user_id})
Fingerprint algorithm: SHA-256 over the canonicalized metadata XML (C14N) to avoid equivalent-doc differences
Signature validation: validate embedded ds:Signature blocks and the certificate validity chain; produce structured errors for expired certs, missing signatures, or algorithm-not-allowed

EntityID normalization: lowercase host, strip default ports, remove duplicate trailing slashes, and canonicalize assertionConsumerService URLs; record normalized->original mapping in metadata attributes
Validation heuristics: classify issues as fatal, warning, or suggest-fix (e.g., missing attribute-consumer-service default index -> suggest index 0)
Audit capture: metadata_fingerprint, metadata_source_url (if applicable), uploader_user_id, ip_address, validation_summary, certificate_serials, and stored_blob_id
Storage: store canonicalized metadata blobs in encrypted metadata store (kms-key: projects/redwood/keys/saml-metadata) with version history
Runtime export: ensure serving runtime accepts the same canonical format; add compatibility layer to translate older blobs during rollout
Rate-limits: throttle remote metadata fetch to 5 requests/min per org to avoid abuse and accidental loops
Security: require org_admin scope on all metadata endpoints; guard against SSRF by restricting fetcher to allowlist of CIDR blocks and by performing DNS rebinding checks
Observability: emit metrics saml.metadata.fetch.success, fetch.failure.reason, validation.fatal.count, validation.warning.count, and audit.log.write.success
ux_notes: Step 1: Choose method - 'Provide metadata URL' or 'Upload XML file' with short help text explaining tradeoffs
Step 2 (URL): fetch preview of top-level EntityDescriptor, display fingerprint, tested cert subjects, last-modified header, and fetch timestamp
Step 2 (Upload): show parsed entityID and primary ACS URL immediately with suggested fixes in a 'Detected issues' panel
Validation UI: errors are shown as 'Blocking' with red badge; non-blocking hints show as amber with one-click 'Apply suggestion'
Final step: 'Confirm and Save' shows a summary card with normalized entityID, fingerprint, and a checkbox 'Record metadata in audit log' (pre-checked, disabled for org_admin)
Accessibility: all error text must be readable by screen readers; keyboard nav for stepper and modal dialogs
Copy: avoid technical jargon where possible; include link 'What is a fingerprint?' that expands inline

audit_logging_requirements: Log entry per metadata change with: initiator_user_id, org_id, action (fetch|upload|activate|revert), metadata_blob_id, metadata_fingerprint (sha256), validation_result (fatal|warnings|ok), validation_details (string), certificate_serials (comma-separated), source_ip, and timestamp
Expose audit entries in Console with filters for action and validation_result
Retention policy: metadata audit entries retained for 2 years in cold storage; recent 90 days searchable in Console
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): feature flag gated, run canary for 10% of orgs with telemetry on validation.fatal.count and audit.log.write.success
Phase 2 (beta): enable for self-serve orgs, collect feedback from SRE and security, monitor for increased support tickets
Phase 3 (GA): rollout to all orgs, enforce org_admin RBAC check and enable strict SSRF allowlist by default
Rollback criteria: if validation.fatal.count spikes > 5x baseline or audit.log.write.failure > 1%, automatically disable URL fetcher and surface manual upload path
